description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the ConceptReferenceRangeUtility class in the OpenMRS project. It tests various evaluation criteria such as age, gender, observation values, and date calculations related to medical concepts and observations.

classes.name: ConceptReferenceRangeUtilityTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the ConceptReferenceRangeUtility class and its evaluation logic.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test method.

methods.name: testAgeInRange_shouldReturnTrueIfAgeIsWithinRange
methods.description: Tests evaluation criterion for age within a range, expecting true.

methods.name: testAgeInRange_shouldReturnFalseIfAgeIsOutsideRange
methods.description: Tests evaluation criterion for age outside the specified range, expecting false.

methods.name: testAgeInRange_shouldReturnTrueIfAgeIsOnBoundary
methods.description: Tests evaluation at age boundary conditions, expecting true.

methods.name: testAgeInMonths_shouldReturnTrueIfAgeIsWithinRange
methods.description: Tests evaluation of age in months within a range.

methods.name: testAgeInRange_shouldThrowExceptionIfCriteriaIsInvalid
methods.description: Verifies that an invalid criteria string throws an APIException.

methods.name: testAgeInRange_shouldThrowAnExceptionIfCriteriaIsEmpty
methods.description: Checks that empty criteria strings throw an IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: testAgeInRange_shouldReturnFalseIfPersonAgeIsNotSet
methods.description: Ensures evaluation returns false when person's age is not available.

methods.name: testGenderMatch_shouldReturnTrueIfGenderMatches
methods.description: Tests gender matching evaluation with matching genders.

methods.name: testGenderMatch_shouldReturnFalseIfGenderDoesNotMatch
methods.description: Tests gender evaluation with non-matching genders.

methods.name: testGenderMatch_shouldReturnFalseIfGenderIsNull
methods.description: Tests gender evaluation when gender is null.

methods.name: testAgeAndGenderMatch_shouldReturnTrueIfAgeAndGenderMatch
methods.description: Tests compound evaluation for age and gender matching; expects true.

methods.name: testAgeAndGenderMatch_shouldReturnTrueIfAgeOrGenderMatch
methods.description: Tests logical OR evaluation with age or gender matching; expects true.

methods.name: testAgeAndGenderMatch_shouldReturnFalseIfAgeDoesNotMatch
methods.description: Ensures false when age does not match criteria.

methods.name: testAgeAndGenderMatch_shouldReturnFalseIfGenderDoesNotMatch
methods.description: Ensures false when gender does not match criteria.

methods.name: testAgeAndGenderMatch_shouldThrowExceptionIfPersonIsNull
methods.description: Validates exception thrown when person (obs) is null.

methods.name: testAgeAndGenderMatch_shouldReturnFalseIfAgeIsNull
methods.description: Ensures false evaluation if person's age is null.

methods.name: testObsValueMatch_shouldReturnTrueIfValueCodedMatch
methods.description: Verifies evaluation for matching coded value in observation.

methods.name: testObsValueMatch_shouldReturnTrueIfValueTextMatch
methods.description: Verifies evaluation for text value match.

methods.name: testObsValueMatch_shouldReturnTrueIfPersonAttributeMatch
methods.description: Checks evaluation when person attribute matches the specified value.

methods.name: testObsValueMatch_shouldReturnFalseIfValueMismatch
methods.description: Ensures evaluation returns false on value mismatch.

methods.name: testTimeOfDay_shouldReturnTrueIfTimeOfDayMatches
methods.description: Tests evaluation for current hour matching at frozen time.

methods.name: testTimeOfDay_shouldReturnFalseIfTimeOfDayDoesNotMatch
methods.description: Ensures evaluation returns false when current hour does not match expected.

methods.name: testRelevantObs_shouldReturnTrueIfCurrentObsHasValidNumericValue
methods.description: Checks evaluation when recent observation has a valid numeric value.

methods.name: testRelevantObs_shouldReturnTrueIfBMIIsInTheExpectedRange
methods.description: Evaluates BMI calculation based on height and weight observations.

methods.name: getObsDays
methods.description: Returns number of days from observation date to current date.

methods.name: getObsWeeks
methods.description: Returns number of weeks from observation date to current date.

methods.name: getObsMonths
methods.description: Returns number of months from observation date to current date.

methods.name: getObsYears
methods.description: Returns number of years from observation date to current date.

methods.name: getObsWeeks_shouldReturnNegativeOneForNullValueDate
methods.description: Checks getObsWeeks method returns -1 when observation date is null.

methods.name: buildObs
methods.description: Utility method to build and initialize an Obs object with default test values.
